bank.title: Turn messy meeting notes into clear actions
bank.hook: You have 40 minutes of notes and no idea what anyone agreed to.
bank.problem: Notes from a meeting are rarely written in an order that shows who must do what.
steps: Paste your own rough notes (remove names of customers and any company data).
Ask for decisions, actions with an owner, and open questions, in three separate lists.
Read it against your notes and fix anything it guessed.
bank.prompt: Here are my rough meeting notes: [paste notes]. List (1) decisions made, (2) actions with an owner and a due date if stated, (3) open questions. If something is not stated, write 'not stated' instead of guessing.
checks: Every owner and date appears in your original notes.
Nothing is listed as decided that was only discussed.
bank.mistake: Letting the AI fill gaps with names or dates it made up.
bank.privacy: Do not paste customer or company data into an AI tool.
